name: Proton VPN Control Center
author: Deniz Kin
description: Native, security-hardened control of the official Proton VPN Linux CLI from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: View Proton VPN status and exit IP, connect, disconnect, and choose a quick-connect target.

schema.label: CLI command
schema.description: Executable name or absolute path for the official Proton VPN CLI.

schema.label: Default country code
schema.description: Two-letter country code selected when the location list opens.

schema.label: Protect untrusted networks
schema.description: Automatically connect Proton VPN on networks not marked trusted.

schema.label: Recover unexpected drops
schema.description: Retry the last server and then the fastest server after an unexpected disconnect.

schema.label: VPN notifications
schema.description: Notify about recovery and forwarded-port changes.
